result.reason: The clause omits workers’ compensation insurance as required by law, so it does not reach either the preferred or fallback package. It also unnecessarily requires all coverage for one year after termination. Renumbering Force Majeure to Section 31 without updating Section 24’s survival reference changes unrelated commercial intent by excluding Force Majeure from the provisions that survive. The cyber trigger should use the defined term “Customer Data,” rather than “Client data.”
